## Thread

An ordered conversation about any card: a `title`, the card it is `about`, `pinned` and `closed` flags, and its `posts`, each with an author, a markdown body and a time. `postCount`, `lastActivityAt` and `lastAuthorName` are derived from the posts, so they cannot drift from them.

```ts
import { Thread } from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/service-desk/thread';
```

Post to Thread is its one writer: posts arrive in order, and a closed thread takes no more.

`about` is `linksTo(CardDef)`, so the same card serves a support case's discussion, a cohort's announcements or a record's comments.

The linked example is the conversation on the checkout 502s case.

### Non-goals

No notifications, reactions or read receipts.
